title: Hall Ticket Download Procedure
steps: Check the official examination notice for hall ticket release announcement
Visit the official portal URL provided in the notice
Log in using PRN/seat number and password
Navigate to 'Hall Ticket' or 'Download Hall Ticket' section
Verify all personal details (name, PRN, photograph, subjects, exam centre)
Download the hall ticket PDF
Print at least two copies on A4 paper
Keep a digital backup on your phone
prerequisites: Hall tickets officially released for your examination
notes: The exact portal URL and release date vary by examination. Always refer to the latest official notice from the SNJB Examination Cell.

title: Hall Ticket Issue Troubleshooting
steps: Confirm hall tickets have been released via official notice
Verify examination form status (submitted, approved, fees paid)
Clear browser cache and cookies
Try incognito/private browsing mode
Try a different browser (Chrome, Firefox, Edge)
Verify correct PRN/seat number and password
Check internet connection
Contact Examination Cell if issue persists
common_issues: Portal not yet open / hall tickets not released
Examination form pending or fees unpaid

title: Exam Day Preparation Checklist

items.text: Exam centre location confirmed, route planned
No mobile phone, smartwatch, or electronic devices

notes: This is general guidance. Confirm specific requirements with your official examination notice and hall ticket instructions. Requirements may vary by examination and subject.

title: Detail Correction Process
steps: Identify the error on your hall ticket (name, photo, subjects, etc.)
Check the official notice for correction deadline and procedure
Prepare required supporting documents (Aadhar, marksheet, etc.)
Submit written application to Examination Cell
Follow up for confirmation before examination
